hook.text: Rock, paper or scissors: who wins?

youtube.title: Rock vs paper vs scissors: who wins? 🪨📄✂️ #shorts
youtube.description:
60 players, 3 teams. Paper covers rock, rock crushes scissors, scissors cut paper: whoever loses joins the winner. Everyone chases its prey and runs from its hunter, a little more aggressive every second (chase = 0.1 + 0.03·t). The graph shows who is winning.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: rock paper scissors, simulation, battle, who wins, satisfying, math, shorts

youtube.title: Rock, paper, scissors, lizard, Spock: who wins? 🖖🦎 #shorts
youtube.description:
Five teams, and each one beats exactly two others. One formula decides every fight: a beats b when (a − b) mod 5 is odd. Watch the alliances shift on the graph.

hook.text: Flowers grow. Scissors cut. Who survives?

youtube.title: Scissors vs flowers: who survives? ✂️🌸 #shorts
youtube.description:
Flowers multiply; scissors hunt them. Every cut feeds a pair of scissors, enough food splits it in two, hunger kills it. Boom, bust, boom: the Lotka–Volterra equations F′ = αF − βFS, S′ = δFS − γS, played out live, with the graph below.
